metadata.title: Mobile Core

props.name: capability
props.remarks: Business capability defining baseline trust requirements for mobile devices accessing institutional systems.

props.name: technology-domain
props.remarks: Mobile platforms, mobile operating systems, platform security features, and device enrollment services.

props.name: architecture-pattern
props.remarks: Foundational Zero Trust pattern defining signal‑based trust for mobile devices without execution trust.

props.name: nist-guidance
props.remarks: Mobile Core aligns with NIST guidance for mobile device security and Zero Trust.

metadata.remarks: Mobile Core defines the immutable baseline capabilities a mobile device must satisfy before it can be considered for conditional access. This pattern explicitly excludes execution trust, configuration hardening, application controls, and lifecycle policy.

components.title: Mobile Device Enrollment and Accountability
components.description: Ensures mobile devices are formally enrolled, uniquely identifiable, and attributable to an owner or custodian.

props.name: attack-technique
props.remarks: Use of unmanaged or unauthorized devices to access services.

props.name: defense-technique
props.remarks: Formal enrollment and device registration establish accountability.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Devices are uniquely identified prior to access.

components.title: Mobile Platform Integrity
components.description: Establishes baseline integrity of the mobile operating system and platform security features.

props.name: attack-technique
props.remarks: Impairment of mobile OS defenses through rooting or jailbreaking.

props.name: defense-technique
props.remarks: Platform‑enforced integrity and verified boot prevent unauthorized modification.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Mechanisms detect unauthorized changes to mobile platform components.

components.title: Mobile Device Protection
components.description: Ensures mobile devices enforce cryptographic protection and user authentication controls.

props.name: attack-technique
props.remarks: Access to data on lost or stolen mobile devices.

props.name: defense-technique
props.remarks: Encryption and lock‑screen authentication protect mobile data.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Mobile device data is protected at rest.
Mobile devices enforce authentication prior to access.

components.title: Mobile Observability
components.description: Ensures security‑relevant mobile device state and events are observable for trust decisions.

props.name: attack-technique
props.remarks: Suppression of security signals to evade detection.

props.name: defense-technique
props.remarks: Posture and telemetry reporting enable detection and response.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Audit generation is enabled for mobile platforms.
